exposure: During debugging, an analytic utility comparison inspected hypothetical initial buyer decisions for seeds101 through120 at all five price multipliers and the three qualified worlds. No full settlement confirmation campaign ran. Those seeds are exposed development inputs and cannot be described as untouched confirmation.
replacement_rule: One fixed consecutive block selected before execution, with no inspection of its buyer draws or outcomes; not adaptively selected for favorable results.
research_claim: This is finite-model engineering confirmation, not evidence of real commercial demand or a statistical discovery test. All development adaptation and failed initial market remain disclosed.
price_selection_adaptation: Higher price eligibility tightened before untouched final block to require GO on every exploratory seed in each qualification world. No qualifying higher offer -> retain initial95%human benchmark with explicit fallback, not assume lower near-AI-cost pricing.
